behavior.arguments: rdi = output pointer, rsi = string pointer, rdx = length
behavior.branch_order: length == 2 is tested first, then length == 3, then the tag-2 fall-through; the length-2 path falls through to tag 2 on mismatch, and the length-3 path falls through to tag 2 on mismatch
behavior.output_shape: byte 0 of output is always 9, byte 1 is the tag, then ret; rax returns the output pointer
behavior.read_width: the length-2 path reads exactly 2 bytes (cmpw); the length-3 path reads exactly 3 bytes (movzwl plus movzbl); other lengths read nothing
behavior.tag_0: length == 3 and first 2 bytes xor 0x6976 ("vi", little-endian) is 0 and byte 2 xor 0x70 ('p') is 0, i.e. the string is exactly "vip"
behavior.tag_1: length == 2 and the 2 bytes equal 0x6d6d, i.e. the string is exactly "mm"
behavior.tag_2: every other input (including length 2 that is not "mm" and length 3 that is not "vip")

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

function.inferred_label: keyword classifier (mm / vip / other), bound alone
